description: Phase 0O.6A (ADR 0052 section 3.9): EXACT-MATCH allowlist for the image filesystem canary/shape scan (lycenza_release.imagescan). An entry matches only one image, one issue code, one path AND the file's exact sha256 -- a changed file is scanned afresh. Reviewed whenever a base digest changes.
